Turtle’s Bridge Builder

Age 4–5 YearsClass 30 · LogicSkill Pattern completion

Square, circle, square… tap the shape that fills the gap in each bridge.

Play the puzzle game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · PATTERN COMPLETION

Turtle’s Bridge Builder

Each bridge has a shape pattern with a gap! Tap the shape that fills the gap.

Square, circle, square… what fills the gap?

Triangle, triangle, circle, triangle, triangle… what fills the gap?

Red, blue, yellow, red, blue… what fills the gap?

All bridges built!

Circle, circle, yellow — Turtle crossed them all.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This game trains pattern completion on the puzzle picture itself: the question is spoken aloud, the answers are pictures, and a miss brings a gentle hint instead of a penalty. Ask your child to explain the rule out loud — saying the “why” is the whole skill.

Prefer paper? The Turtle’s Bridge Builder worksheet prints the same puzzle with room to draw, sort and circle — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
